decision.reasoning_trace: I filtered the feed for actual backpacks, excluding towels, pillows, and other unrelated accessories. My consideration set includes a tactical large-capacity bag, two hydration packs for hiking, a foldable daypack for travel, and a sling bag for light use. I selected the Gelindo 18L Hiking Hydration Backpack (prod_backpacks_078) as the final choice because it has the highest average rating in the set (4.7) and reviews highlight specific useful features like the front-strap zipper pocket for phones and credit cards, which provides superior utility compared to standard hydration packs at a similar price point.
